rows.current: Takes a 3D scene and writes it to a Collada 1.4.1 .dae file, producing a file you can open in 3D viewers or use in later analysis. It can name files from metadata and optionally index meshes to reduce file size. This algorithm groups the incoming data based on the annotations. Those groups can consist of one data item per slot.
rows.name: Export 3D scene

rows.current: Merges the input scenes into one This algorithm groups the incoming data based on the annotations. Those groups can consist of multiple data items. If you want to group all data into one output, set the matching strategy to 'Custom' and leave 'Data set matching annotations' empty.
rows.name: Merge 3D scenes
